name: 66605 · Topeka, KS
findings: ZIP 66605 (Topeka) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66605 (Topeka) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
